title: Version executor schema
description: Idempotent wrapper around @jscutlery/semver:version. Checks if version tag already exists before delegating.

dryRun.description: See what commands would be run, without committing to git or updating files.

noVerify.description: Bypass pre-commit or commit-msg git hooks during the commit phase.

releaseAs.description: Manually increment the version by that keyword.

preid.description: Use the next semantic prerelease version with a specific prerelease identifier.

tagPrefix.description: Version tag prefix. Default is '{projectName}@' in independent mode.

postTargets.description: Specify the targets to run after a new version was successfully created.

trackDeps.description: Includes the project's dependencies in calculating a recommended version bump.

allowEmptyRelease.description: Allow bumping versions even if there are no changes in the library.

skipCommit.description: Allows to skip making a commit when bumping a version.

skipTag.description: Allows to skip tagging the release.

section.description: Changelog section header for this type.

hidden.description: If true, commits of this type are hidden from changelog and don't trigger version bumps.

preset.description: Customize Conventional Changelog preset. Can be a preset name or custom configuration object.

commitMessageFormat.description: A string to be used to format the auto-generated release commit message.

skipCommitTypes.description: Specify array of commit types to be ignored when calculating next version bump.

updateDependents.description: Update version references in dependent packages after version bump.

skipIfVersionCommit.description: Skip versioning if the current commit is a version/release commit (recursion prevention).

skipIfUnstableGit.description: Skip versioning if git is in rebase/merge state.

collectFiles.description: Output list of modified files without staging. Implies skipCommit and skipTag. When combined with --dryRun, reports files that would be modified.
